correctness.rationale: Centered worker shifts remove offsets b_i. Bernoulli half-dropout produces exact second-moment recursion on X=E x², Y=E x ebar, W=E mean e_i²; independent recomputation in sympy confirms M_n(s), char polynomial and P(1)=s[n(2+s-s²)-2s(s+2)]/(4n). Complete Jury inequalities are positive on 0<s<s_n as factored proof shows; at s_n P(1)=0, beyond necessary positivity fails. Conditional noise independence and all square-integrable initial states are in scope; arbitrary gamma<=0 not claimed. Asymptotic expansion and monotonicity checked.
